Name: Seasonal Save Slots
Author: TheTrain2000
Description:
Adds seasonal flair to save slots in the load game menu.

[list]
[*]Colored line at the top of each save slot
[*]Season icon next to the farm name on each save slot
[/list]
The changes that the mod introduces can be individually enabled or disabled through the configuration file or with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿.
